facility.name: Legacy Christian Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 4151 CULEBRA RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78228

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: According to the Texas Comptroller website, the business entity's Franchise Tax Account Status is Inactive/Forfeited. The operation is currently providing care to children with an inactive status.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: It is determined that one caregiver does not have a valid High School Diploma/GED in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director is not ensuring the center is operating in compliance with MS when the director did not verify multiple caregivers education credentials.  The director also did not ensure that First-Aid/CPR cards provided to her upon hire were legitimate
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: It was determined that three caregiver's did not have first aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Based on information gathered, it was determined that fire drills are conducted every two months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: During the walkthrough, an infant was observed sleeping with a bib on.     Note: The bib was removed immediately
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 years of age and within weight and height limit of child safety seat: The driver failed to provide a child with the required booster seat during transportation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 years of age and within weight and height limit of child safety seat (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Crib sheets were observed to be loose fitting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: A trash can observed on the playground containing garbage did not have a lid.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when a lid was placed on the trash can.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning supplies were observed in the cabinet underneath the sink in the children's restroom with no child proof lock making them accessible to the children in care.       Note: This was corrected at inspection when the cleaning products were removed out of children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: Two mattresses were observed stacked on top of each other in a crib in the infant classroom.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the bottom mattress was removed leaving one in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: Bandages and a thermometer were missing from the van first aid kit. This was CORRECTED AT INSPECTION.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The weed prevention mesh under the pea gravel was observed to be pulled up.    This was CORRECTED AT INSPECTION when the mesh was cut.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: A caregiver in the Toddler room did not know the ages of the children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Children were observed eating snack while watching tv.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Caregivers in the infant room did not know the ages of the children in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The weed prevention mesh under the pea gravel was observed to be pulled up creating a tripping hazard.  Trash was observed on the playground.  A gate leading to the playground was observed to be broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A person without a cleared background check was observed caring for children.    Note: This person was sent home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver was observed to be asleep when caring for a group of children.    Note: The caregiver is no longer present at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Parent's Rights were not added to the operational policies.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the operational policies were added.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The lighting in the classroom was not adequate.   Note: This was corrected at inspection as the Director the light was turned on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Three cribs were not labeled with child's name.     Note:  Corrected at inspection when director labeled the cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not provide/share and incident report with parents of children who escaped the playground through a side gate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Caregivers and directors are not recording accidents or incidents that children are involved in on the Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form 7239 or another form that contains at least the same information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed: Caregivers are not completing the incident reporting forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed (26 TAC §746.705)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to notify CCR as soon after the incident as possible, but no later than two days after.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The caregivers did not provide the level of supervision necessary to ensure each child?s safety and well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on-going activity when they were outside playing in the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: The operation failed to notify parents of the situation their child was in when the children escaped through the side playground gate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The operation did not have the current employees list, menu and daily activity schedule posted.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the required documents were posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Exercise Rings, Trapeze Bars, Free-Swinging Ropes: Trapeze bars were observed on long chains in the playground during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Exercise Rings, Trapeze Bars, Free-Swinging Ropes (26 TAC §746.4603(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Allows Children To Fall Inside Structure Onto Other Parts: There was a prohibited play structure observed on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Allows Children To Fall Inside Structure Onto Other Parts (26 TAC §746.4603(2))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: No loose fill surfacing material was installed under the slide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure: Swings were observed attached to a composite structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure (26 TAC §746.4701(c))
